issue.title: Intention Card e2e YAML excursion: Done never returns to the card editor and invalid YAML shows no refusal
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-oj.5.1.4 (note #1, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP) and triaged by the bob-cli-oj.5.1 land agent. Not caused by the group-rail epic: the failure reproduces on the pre-epic base.

## What fails

`scripts/obsidian-intention-card-e2e.cjs` (real Obsidian on athena, xvfb, isolated profile) fails two YAML-excursion cases:

- `yaml-done-returns`: `Timed out waiting for "reopened after Done"`. Clicking the Done control never returns to the card editor.
- `yaml-invalid-stays-recoverable`: no visible refusal notice appears.

Both cases fail identically on bob-plugins 7b44b29 (pre-epic base, same bob binary; report artifact file:explicit:6b137795cc0d19303166545e) and on the final merged tree da0737b (file:explicit:003cd62b2c9be7f840066a24). The other 80 cases pass.

## Next step

Rerun the two cases on current origin/master. Bisect the Done-control return path in the intention card editor (297c* fragments) against the title-block adoption commits (bob-cli-o6.5, eed318e) and fix whichever side regressed. Keep the e2e cases unchanged unless the contract changed on purpose.

payload.entry: ATTRIBUTION SETTLED (bob-cli-o6 land agent, 2026-11-21): the regression is NOT from the title-block epic; it was introduced exactly by bob-plugins 7b44b29 'feat(ledger-tools): paint group arms and hints in the links walker footer' (bob-cli-oj.6). Evidence, same debug bob (built from bob-cli 6b9139a6) and same harness on athena: at 9a15d52 (= 7b44b29~1, which contains every bob-cli-o6 commit in the regression window, including a68e29b, b8b7baf, 1a95b29, c803a4e) the full e2e passes 82/82 including yaml-done-returns and yaml-invalid-stays-recoverable (file:explicit:8290d9715c1214421e92b848); at 7b44b29 yaml-done-returns fails with the same 'Timed out waiting for reopened after Done' (file:explicit:a9a0d0dd3ca2361e423565a4; yaml-invalid passed in this single run, so it is a sometimes-cascading secondary). No bisect is needed: fix forward in the links-walker-footer group-arms change. Code pointers: every intentions YAML-Done fragment (242e, 297a/b/d/e, 297ca/cb) is byte-identical between the passing and failing trees; 7b44b29 reworked 124-links-walker-footer.js (+320 lines) and 121-freshness-footer-paint.js, and the unstyled Done button (242e albumYamlBuildDoneEl, appended to view.containerEl with no CSS rule) sits in the same bottom-of-pane region the footer paints, consistent with the CDP click at the button center landing on footer chrome. Zero notices in the invalid case also fits a swallowed click: every albumYamlDone failure path posts a Notice except the silent completionPromise reuse.

payload.description: Epic bob-cli-o6 is linked related: possible Done-control return-path regression from o6.5; need status before landing the epic

payload.entry: Fixed by the bob-cli-oj land agent in bob-ledger-tools 1.157.1 (bob-plugins, landing commit on top of 28d76fd). Root cause, proven with a new hit-test assertion in the e2e clickDone: the YAML-excursion Done control had no CSS. It was appended to the leaf's containerEl, so it stretched into a full-width bar at the pane bottom, and Obsidian's floating status bar covers that spot. Once bob-cli-oj.6 (7b44b29) widened the links walker footer with group arms, the status bar covered the button's centre (elementFromPoint = DIV.status-bar-item plugin-properties), so the real click never reached Done. yaml-invalid failed the same way. Fix: albumYamlDoneAnchor mounts Done just above .view-content (under the view header), styled as a compact mod-cta button at the top left. The top right was rejected because the refusal notice then covered Done; the e2e proved it. The e2e clickDone now asserts the control is not covered before clicking. Added a unit test for the mount position. Evidence: before file:explicit:8575826c2e1c03c5f0632d87 (80/82, covered by status-bar-item) plus screenshot file:explicit:20d004eff4ac80fb4c3e2bcf; after file:explicit:222f8b8c90e888648853404e (82/82) plus screenshot file:explicit:fe38a1bb6d78093df0d04a5e. record-card e2e 180/180; album UI e2e 129/130, with the only failure being pre-existing bob-cli-nq, identical on the stashed base; excursion unit tests 12/12; npm test red only on the wall-clock flakes bob-cli-io/km/m1, all passing alone. Deployed with bob plugins sync -p bob-ledger-tools.
